Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
"When Topaz successfully equips from your hand, you may look at your prey's hand,
and Topaz may take an equipment from it instead (discard the original
equipment card)."

In the thread surrounding this post:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/173e83fa25b5915f

It is stated that you can use Kiss of Lachesis to get a Flaming Candle out of
an ash heap multiple times, and even have multiples in play, because it is not
"playing" or "equipping".

So here's the situation:
Flaming Candle has been played earlier this game.
I control Topaz, and Topaz takes a successful Equip action to get a Leather
Jacket.
I look at my prey's hand, and see a Flaming Candle there.
Can I "take" it, by Topaz's card text?

I think yes, but I got challenged.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.
That is neither playing it nor equipping it. Topaz played and equipped the
Leather Jacket, then took (moved) the Flaming Candle.

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/fd88dba47f8061f4
